page.overview:
Who is Bonwhin Meraighdin?

Bonwhin Meraighdin was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat.

Her name could indicate that she was from Fel Moreina in Esandara, given that -in is a common ending of names in Far Madding of both first names and surnames in the New Era; as common are long surnames.

She was born in FY 738 and was elected Amyrlin from the Red Ajah in , the same year as Guaire Amalasan declared himself as the Dragon Reborn and Bonwhin ruled for more than fifty years, one of the longest reigns in the history of the White Tower.

But finally, her attempt at controlling Artur Hawkwing as a puppet led to disaster. All the Aes Sedai were expelled from Hawkwing's empire and his armies put a nineteen-year-long siege to Tar Valon.
